lede: Dallas Cowboys carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#9 in EPA per play), while Philadelphia Eagles owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#8 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Philadelphia Eagles −3.0 with a fair total of 45.5 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Philadelphia Eagles pass offence vs Dallas Cowboys pass defence, which sits +0.152 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
